Subject: Vendor invite acceptance intermittently fails — Eskalon

Hi Sergio,

We received the supplier invite this morning but the ‘Accept’ button is acting up for several users on our side. Clicking it either reloads the same accept page or takes us to a generic login and then back to the accept page (no error message). Two of our users were able to accept after 6–7 attempts; others still see the loop.

This is blocking PO #ESK-2026-179 (pending vendor acceptance). We tried Chrome and Edge, cleared cache, and tried again — same behavior. I attached a screenshot and a HAR of the click attempt.

Invite link (copied from invite email): https://app.coupa.com/invite/0a1b2c3d

Can you confirm if this is a known intermittent issue? We’re happy to provide a Zoom and screen-share if that helps. PO needs to be finalized today.

Thanks — Marta
Marta Ruiz
Procurement Manager, Eskalon Manufacturing

Hi Marta — thanks for the report and the attachments. Sorry for the disruption; I can see why this is urgent.

Quick troubleshooting steps we recommend while we investigate:
- Try the invite link in a private/incognito window and paste the full invite URL (not the email button).
- Confirm the time on the machine and try within 10 minutes of opening the link (some invites use short-lived tokens).
- If possible, forward the original invite email to me so I can validate the raw headers.

I’ve CC’d Ben (account lead) and Marissa from Operations in case we need to escalate to a portal hotfix or do a manual vendor creation. Ben/Marissa — can we check server logs for 0a1b2c3d between 08:30–09:30 PT and look for any 302 loops or session cookie resets?

If you’re available, I can do a quick screenshare at 11:00 to reproduce.

— Sergio
